meta.title: Documents
meta.description: A Word-like document editor inside DeepSeek Harness. Open the Documents icon in the left sidebar to get a seven-tab ribbon (File, Home, Insert, Design, Layout, References, View), an editable page with tables and images, and DOCX, Apple Pages, legacy DOC, ODT, RTF, HTML, Markdown and text import. Click into the page and type: Enter splits paragraphs, Backspace merges them, selection and caret formatting (font, size, bold/italic/underline, colour, alignment, lists, styles, spacing) go through the same engine as the agent tools, and Ctrl+S saves. Insert tables, images, page and section breaks, hyperlinks, header and footer text, a generated table of contents, footnotes and equations; change margins, orientation, paper size and columns; adjust zoom, ruler and formatting marks. Export DOCX, PDF, HTML, Markdown, ODT or RTF. The agent can work on the same document with 26 document_* tools. Files are read only from the configured workspace plus the session working directory, every write stays inside the workspace, document text is treated as untrusted data, and macros are never executed. AI review and summarisation work offline; rewriting, translation and generation need a configured model provider. Unsupported Word features (page colour, shapes, symbols, captions, cross-references, page-number fields in headers) are shown disabled with an explanation rather than faked. PDF import, Google Docs API access and macro execution are not supported.
